facts.title: First Aid in Orgrimmar: Arnok, vials and spices
facts.location: Arnok, Valley of Spirits; Xen'to (spices), Kor'geld (vials)
facts.note: Minor Healing Potion at First Aid 55: Peacebloom, Mild Spices and an Empty Vial, so it uses herbs you already pick.

facts.title: Expert First Aid is a book, off the route
facts.location: Balai Lok'Wein, Brackenwall Village, Dustwallow Marsh
facts.note: Trainers stop at 150. The book Under Wraps needs First Aid 125. Artisan is the Triage quest at level 35, untested in the beta.
